score_notes.A: Arc is TL;DR, background, method, implementation, results, significance/limitations; no body H1, no skipped levels, real table, display math has blank lines. Deductions: L51 '정답 궤적 A(비용 $0.10)와 B(비용 $0.40)' uses two bare single dollars on one line, which inline-$ MathJax pairs into a math span (rubric: no single $). Headings are topic names, not claims: L19 '연구 배경', L29 '제안 방법', L57 '구현 방식', L69 '실험 결과', L95 '의의와 한계'.
score_notes.B: Consistent 입니다 register. Deductions: L31 '체인 오브 소트로 상황을 분석하고' transliteration (-> 'Chain-of-Thought(CoT) 추론으로 상황을 분석하고'); L35 noun frame '주목할 부분은 세 종류의 도구가 같은 인터페이스로 묶여 있다는 점입니다' (-> '세 종류의 도구는 모두 같은 인터페이스로 묶입니다'); L97 '프런티어 모델을 넘을 수 있음을 보여 줍니다' (-> '프런티어 모델을 넘습니다'); L99 formulaic '한계도 분명합니다.'; L31 '마르코프 결정 과정', L55 '어드밴티지', '클리핑된 대리 목적 함수' with no English term on first use.
score_notes.C: Bias motivation (L23-27) leads to the reward design and is reused in results (L87). Deductions: L55 introduces GRPO's clipped surrogate objective and never returns to it; L93 packs unseen-tool generalization, unseen pricing and preference results into one paragraph.
score_notes.D: Reward vector, batch min-max normalisation and preference dot product get a formula plus a labelled toy example (L51) and a key-idea box (L53). Deductions: L51 example omits C's cost, so 'A가 1, B가 0으로 정규화' only holds if C's cost lies between A's and B's; L55 GRPO clipping unexplained; L93 preference scores '46.7, 68.4, 79.5' are sums of a Qwen3-8B-relative reward (Appendix L) but the reader learns this only in L99.
score_notes.E: One results table copied cell-for-cell from the main comparison table (L75-83, all 42 cells match), three figures placed at their discussion, described without paper numbering. Deductions: L85 misdescribes the cut rows; L93's 12 generalization/preference numbers would read better as a small table.
score_notes.F: 14 of 15 sampled claims supported, 1 wrong: L85 '도구 없음 구성과 Llama 계열 일부 행은 생략했습니다' understates the cut (the existing-SOTA rows, the basic-tools Qwen3-8B/Llama-Nemotron-49B/Llama-3.3-70B/Qwen3-235B-A22B rows and every Llama row of the full-tool block are also gone, not 'some' Llama rows). L27 'Orchestrator-8B는 GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, Qwen3-32B에 호출을 비교적 고르게' rests on the figure; the text says only 'more balanced tool calls'. The L51 toy example is labelled '설명용 가상 수치', so it is not counted as invented.
score_notes.G: description is 146 characters, plain text, opens with 'ToolOrchestra', numbers (37.1%, 35.1%, 2.5배) all from the TL;DR; use_math true with $$ present. Deduction: single $ in L51 would trip the math lint/rendering; '8B' left unconverted in the description and L17 ('80억') is inconsistent.
score_notes.U1: All five questions answered: motivation (L21-27), solution (L31-55), implementation (L59-67), results (L71-93), significance (L97-99).
score_notes.U2: About a five-minute read; plain-prose TL;DR without math; one distilled results table; grounded limitations (L99: text-only HLE subset, unreproduced 84.2, GPT-5 judge, provider pricing, relative preference metric). Minor: L93 is dense.
score_notes.X1: Category Agentic-AI fits. Seven tags is many: 'Agentic-AI' repeats the category, 'Reasoning-Models' names something the paper does not study, 'Synthetic-Tool-Use-Environments' is not a paper term (the paper says 'synthetic data' and 'ToolScale'); ToolScale itself is not tagged.
